faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JK Bank Advisor (Treasury Operations) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the JK Bank Advisor (Treasury Operations) position is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a CA, MBA Finance, CFA, PGDM, or another relevant post-graduate qualification from a recognized University or Institution. A Certificate in Treasury Management or Certified Treasury Dealer Course is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) post is 61 years. There is a provision for age relaxation of up to 2 years for suitable candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 3,00,000 to Rs. 3,75,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Advisor (Treasury Operations) in the Jammu and Kashmir Bank recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the JK Bank Advisor (Treasury Operations) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is Rs. 1000/- (Inclusive of GST). This fee must be paid online during the application process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) post involves screening, shortlisting of candidates, and a final interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Advisor (Treasury Operations) post is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the JK Bank Advisor (Treasury Operations) position?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official JK Bank website or by using the direct "Apply Online" link provided in the "Important Links" section. Ensure you fill out the form accurately and submit it by the last date.
